name: 60805 · Evergreen Pk, IL
findings: ZIP 60805 (Evergreen Pk) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60805 (Evergreen Pk) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60805 (Evergreen Pk) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).
